assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PRODUCTION skeletal animation parts ATLAS, not a character sheet, for Local Manifestation, a contemporary 2D orthographic action game.
Input image is identity and style reference ONLY. Preserve exactly that actor's clothing, anatomy and palette, but split the subject into isolated independent cutout parts.
Canvas is LANDSCAPE 1536 pixels wide × 1024 pixels high. Fixed INVISIBLE regular grid EXACTLY 6 COLUMNS × 4 ROWS, 24 equal cells, each 256×256 pixels. No extra margins that change cell centers.
Rows, top to bottom: 1 FRONT facing screen DOWN (show face); 2 BACK facing screen UP (show rear head, no face); 3 RIGHT side facing screen RIGHT; 4 LEFT side facing screen LEFT. Body view is upright orthographic slightly overhead, same game-camera elevation and scale for all rows. NOT action poses.
Columns, left to right in EVERY row: 1 BODY / torso only; 2 HEAD / upper feature only; 3 entire ARM_LEFT from shoulder to hand; 4 entire ARM_RIGHT from shoulder to hand; 5 entire LEG_LEFT from hip to foot; 6 entire LEG_RIGHT from hip to foot. Arms and legs are named from actor's own left/right. Side rows MUST STILL have both distinct arm cells and both distinct leg cells.
Every one of the 24 cells contains EXACTLY ONE detached part at its cell center, no complete people. Never draw arms/legs/head attached to torso. Long axis of every limb is upright vertical in the image, shoulder/hip socket at its top and hand/foot at bottom, relaxed straight shape; face or shoe points according to row. A small overlap allowance on joint ends. Parts remain fully inside their cell, 20 pixel transparent gap from every cell edge; no part touches another cell.
Unified style: modern restrained hand-painted 2D indie game art, matte cloth/polymer/steel, deep-charcoal clean outlines, simple broad opaque shapes and sparse brushed texture, graphite gray / ash gray / warm white with tiny muted teal functional accents. Not photorealism, 3D render, pixel art, medieval fantasy, runes or steampunk.
Genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the parts. NO grid lines, no boxes, no captions, no row/column labels, no words, no digits, no background, no floor, no cast shadows, no weapons or handheld equipment, no full-body silhouettes in any cell.
Actor identity and required anatomy: A lean everyday explorer in a light warm-gray hood-down field jacket with a slim charcoal cross-body pouch and muted teal buckle, dark straight trousers, low soft shoes, dark cap over short dark hair. Torso includes jacket body, hood behind neck, pouch and strap only. Head includes cap, short hair and neutral face. Arms are individual gray sleeves ending in bare hands; legs are individual dark trouser legs ending in soft shoes. Keep the slim silhouette and contemporary clothing.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PRODUCTION skeletal animation parts ATLAS, not a character sheet, for Local Manifestation, a contemporary 2D orthographic action game.
Input image is identity and style reference ONLY. Preserve exactly that actor's clothing, anatomy and palette, but split the subject into isolated independent cutout parts.
Canvas is LANDSCAPE 1536 pixels wide × 1024 pixels high. Fixed INVISIBLE regular grid EXACTLY 6 COLUMNS × 4 ROWS, 24 equal cells, each 256×256 pixels. No extra margins that change cell centers.
Rows, top to bottom: 1 FRONT facing screen DOWN (show face); 2 BACK facing screen UP (show rear head, no face); 3 RIGHT side facing screen RIGHT; 4 LEFT side facing screen LEFT. Body view is upright orthographic slightly overhead, same game-camera elevation and scale for all rows. NOT action poses.
Columns, left to right in EVERY row: 1 BODY / torso only; 2 HEAD / upper feature only; 3 entire ARM_LEFT from shoulder to hand; 4 entire ARM_RIGHT from shoulder to hand; 5 entire LEG_LEFT from hip to foot; 6 entire LEG_RIGHT from hip to foot. Arms and legs are named from actor's own left/right. Side rows MUST STILL have both distinct arm cells and both distinct leg cells.
Every one of the 24 cells contains EXACTLY ONE detached part at its cell center, no complete people. Never draw arms/legs/head attached to torso. Long axis of every limb is upright vertical in the image, shoulder/hip socket at its top and hand/foot at bottom, relaxed straight shape; face or shoe points according to row. A small overlap allowance on joint ends. Parts remain fully inside their cell, 20 pixel transparent gap from every cell edge; no part touches another cell.
Unified style: modern restrained hand-painted 2D indie game art, matte cloth/polymer/steel, deep-charcoal clean outlines, simple broad opaque shapes and sparse brushed texture, graphite gray / ash gray / warm white with tiny muted teal functional accents. Not photorealism, 3D render, pixel art, medieval fantasy, runes or steampunk.
Genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the parts. NO grid lines, no boxes, no captions, no row/column labels, no words, no digits, no background, no floor, no cast shadows, no weapons or handheld equipment, no full-body silhouettes in any cell.
Actor identity and required anatomy: A hunched faceless charcoal-coated dragger, pale long oblong featureless head, oversized charcoal coat, impossibly long broad heavy sleeves with muted teal open cuffs reaching below short feet. Body is short charcoal TORSO ONLY, no head or sleeves or feet. Head is isolated pale oblong blank mask; back head is dark rear hood with no facial marks. Arms are separate very long heavy angular cloth sleeves ending in teal-lined square cuffs; legs are short separate dark stumps ending in tiny plain shoes. No tentacles, no gore.
FINAL CRITICAL CHECK: body is a SLEEVELESS torso with no mask, no sleeves. Keep every part narrower than180px and shorter than210px to ensure32pixel transparent grid gutters; total6×4 grid1536×1024. Row3 both short feet point right, row4 both point left. True transparent hard clean alpha with no hazy dust or background.
assets.final_fix_prompt: Edit ONLY THE FIRST COLUMN in all four rows of this1536×1024 six-column four-row transparent skeletal atlas. These four charcoal body parts currently have tiny attached feet/leg stumps below the coat. REMOVE those attached feet/leg stumps entirely. Leave just the short sleeveless coat trunk, ending at the coat hem, with a small hip overlap stub hidden under the hem but NO visible shoes or legs. Detached legs in columns5/6 are correct and must stay exactly unchanged, as do heads and long teal-cuff sleeves. Maintain all24 cell centers, row facing directions, materials, colors, exact6×4 layout and actual alpha0 background. No new marks, grid, shadows or background.
